text: Hello, I'm a childminder and I've got an 11 year old girl staying over tonight while her dad's away for work, he's said it's fine for me to contact you if I'm unsure about anything. I honestly don't know if this is even worth a message so apologies in advance if I'm wasting your time. She's had a temperature this evening, it was 39.2 when I checked about half an hour ago with the ear thermometer. The thing is she just won't settle to sleep. She's been up and down, back in the lounge, says she can't get comfy, then goes back to bed and five minutes later she's up again. Apart from that she seems fine in herself, honestly, she's been chatting to me normally and having a drink and she's not complaining of anything else. I just wasn't sure whether the not settling is something I should be paying attention to or whether it's just because she's hot and in a different house. I've given her a cool flannel and opened the window a little. Her dad isn't picking up so I thought I'd ask someone who actually knows. Is there anything else I should be doing or should I just keep an eye on her through the night?
